item.title: Colorado - Wikipedia
item.description: Colorado is noted for its landscape of mountains, forests, high plains, mesas, canyons, plateaus, rivers, and desert lands. It encompasses most of the Southern Rocky Mountains, as well as the northeastern portion of the Colorado Plateau and the western edge of the Great Plains.

item.title: Colorado Maps & Facts - World Atlas
item.description: Colorado is a landlocked state located in the central United States. It borders Kansas in the east, Utah in the west, Arizona in the southwest, Nebraska and Wyoming in the North, and New Mexico and Oklahoma in the south.

item.title: Geography of Colorado - Wikipedia
item.description: The geography of the U.S. State of Colorado is diverse, encompassing rugged mountainous terrain, vast plains, desert lands, desert canyons, and mesas. Colorado is a landlocked U.S. state.

item.description: Geographical and historical treatment of Colorado, including maps and a survey of its people, economy, and government.
